landmarks.name: Snow and Blood
landmarks.description:
Prerequisites:
Complete the "Ledger of Atonement" questline on the Mountain of Imprisonment: first complete Moji's Relics, defeat the Ascetic Iron Mask, and obtain the key to the small backstreet courtyard in Pangzhen.

How to Obtain:
Once you have the key to the backstreet courtyard in Pangzhen, go to the Green Serpent House, cross the bridge, and open the gate beside Old Man Gen's House. Climb onto the roof to enter Bai Xue's home.
Place the Bloodstained Necklace beside her true body, then interact with the trunk of the large tree in the courtyard to obtain the accessory.

Effect:
When there are bleeding enemies nearby, damage dealt to enemies +10%, and bleeding damage enemies take during their attack animations +20%.

landmarks.name: [Read the Description] Pangzhen Starting Point
landmarks.description:
This is the largest map in the game, and its winding layout can make it hard to find your way using the map alone.
Since one branching path generally leads to another, try fully exploring the previous branch whenever you reach the next junction. This can make thorough exploration much easier.

Because there is so much content, all Upgrade Materials and Remnant Dust locations are hidden by default on the map. Enable them manually if you need them.
